name: apps-script-cache
description: Caches slow Google Apps Script /exec responses in MongoDB and serves them instantly from a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-assets-dir.mjs && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c blue,green "wrangler dev --test-scheduled --port 8787" "npm --workspace web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:worker: npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker
